summary: Lower Promise.prototype.then on a proven intrinsic Promise while preserving queued reactions and derived-promise resolution.

target.notes: Handlers run as Promise jobs, non-callable handlers are ignored, returned values/thenables resolve the derived promise, and thrown values reject it.

caveats: ContinueWith is not a semantic substitute because scheduler, exception, and chaining behavior differ.
Promise subclass/species cases require the runtime species rule.

tests.name: missing handler propagates and throw rejects
tests.expected_behavior: value 5 passes through the non-callable handler and derived promise rejects with e
